required.quote: a person is not eligible for renewal of a license to practice dentistry, other than a permit issued under s. 447.02 (3), unless the person has taught, attended, or otherwise completed, during the 2-year period immediately preceding the renewal date specified under s. 440.08 (2) (a), 30 credit hours of continuing education

hours_per_period.quote: 30 credit hours of continuing education related to the practice of dentistry or the practice of medicine, including not less than 25 credit hours of instruction in clinical dentistry or clinical medicine

topical_requirements.quote: including not less than 25 credit hours of instruction in clinical dentistry or clinical medicine. Not more than 4 of the 30 hours may be from teaching.

title_protection.quote: Use or permit to be used, directly or indirectly, for a profit or otherwise for himself or herself, or for any other person, the title, or append to his or her name the words or letters, "doctor", "Dr.", "Doctor of Dental Surgery", "D.D.S.", or "D.M.D.", or any other letters, titles, degrees, terms or descriptive matter

scope_protection.quote: no person may do any of the following unless he or she is licensed to practice dentistry under this subchapter or holds a compact privilege to practice dentistry: (a) Practice or offer to practice dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional conduct or violated the standards of conduct established by the examining board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in unprofessional conduct or violated the standards of conduct established by the examining board under s. 447.02 (2) (g).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made any false statement or gave false information in connection with an application for a license, certificate, or registration, or received a license through error.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made any false statement or given any false information in connection with an application for a license, certificate, or registration or for renewal or reinstatement of a license, certificate, or registration, or received a license, certificate, or registration through error.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been adjudicated mentally incompetent by a court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudicated mentally incompetent by a court.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sent impressions or measurements to a dental laboratory without a written work authorization, or sent a patient to a dental laboratory for purposes other than shade verification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly or indirectly sent, for a purpose other than shade verification, impressions or measurements to a dental laboratory without a written work authorization on a form approved by the examining board and signed by the authorizing dentist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been convicted of a crime whose circumstances substantially relate to the practice of dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to ss. 111.321, 111.322, and 111.335, been convicted of a crime, the circumstances of which substantially relate to the practice of dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated this subchapter or any federal or state statute or rule that relates to the practice of dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated this subchapter or any federal or state statute or rule that relates to the practice of dentistry, dental therapy, dental hygiene, or an expanded function dental auxiliary, or the operation of a mobile dentistry program.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced dentistry while ability was impaired by alcohol or other drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to ss. 111.321, 111.322 and 111.34, practiced dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene or as an expanded function dental auxiliary while his or her ability was impaired by alcohol or other drugs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct indicating a lack of knowledge, inability to apply, or negligent application of principles or skills of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in conduct that indicates a lack of knowledge of, an inability to apply or the negligent application of, principles or skills of dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene or the practice of an expanded function dental auxiliary.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or attempted to obtain compensation by fraud or deceit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtained or attempted to obtain compensation by fraud or deceit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed, directly or indirectly, any unlicensed or uncertified person to perform any act requiring licensure or certification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed, directly or indirectly, any unlicensed or uncertified person to perform any act requiring licensure or certification under this subchapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in repeated irregularities in billing a third party for services rendered to a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in repeated irregularities in billing a 3rd party for services rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made a substantial misrepresentation in the course of practice that was relied upon by a client.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made a substantial misrepresentation in the course of practice, or in the operation of a mobile dentistry program, that was relied upon by a client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any order of the examining board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any order of the examining board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised by using a statement that tends to deceive or mislead the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertised by using a statement that tends to deceive or mislead the public.

definition_quote.value: the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including surgery, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human oral cavity or its adjacent or associated tissues and structures, or of the maxillofacial area, and their impact on the human body.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including surgery, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human oral cavity or its adjacent or associated tissues and structures, or of the maxillofacial area, and their impact on the human body.

value: administering vaccines against SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus and influenza
methods_authorized.quote: "Dentistry" means the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including surgery, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human oral cavity or its adjacent or associated tissues and structures, or of the maxillofacial area, and their impact on the human body.

drug_authority.value: Dentists may administer vaccines against SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus and influenza without a prescription order if they meet specified training and insurance requirements.
drug_authority.quote: A dentist may administer without a prescription order a vaccine against SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus or influenza only if he or she satisfies all of the following

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: The standards, conditions and any educational requirements that are in addition to the requirements specified in s. 447.04 (1) that must be met by a dentist to be permitted to induce general anesthesia or conscious sedation in connection with the practice of dentistry.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means that the dentist is present in the dental office or other practice setting, personally diagnoses the condition to be treated, personally authorizes each procedure, and before dismissal of the patient, evaluates the performance of the allied dental personnel. ... "General supervision" means that the dentist is not present in the dental office or other practice setting or on the premises at the time tasks or procedures are being performed by the dental therapist ... "Indirect supervision" means that the dentist is present in the dental office or other practice setting, authorizes each procedure, and remains in the office while the procedures are being performed by the allied dental personnel.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Prior to providing any dental therapy services, a dental therapist shall enter into a written collaborative management agreement with a qualifying dentist who will serve as a supervising dentist

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: No dentist may have collaborative management agreements with more than 4 dental therapists at any time.

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: The examining board shall grant a license to practice dental therapy to an individual who does all of the following

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: a dental therapist licensed under this chapter may provide dental therapy services in this state only under the direct supervision or indirect supervision of a qualifying dentist with whom the dental therapist has entered into a collaborative management agreement.

value: A dentist with whom the dental therapist has entered into a collaborative management agreement
A school district or the operator of a private school or a tribal school
The operator of a school for the education of dentists or dental hygienists
A state or federal prison, a county jail, or other federal, state, county, or municipal correctional or detention facility, or a facility established to provide care for terminally ill patients
A charitable institution open to the general public or to members of a religious sect or order
A nonprofit home health care agency
The operator of a nonprofit dental care program serving primarily indigent, economically disadvantaged, or migrant worker populations
dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist may, subject to par. (e), provide dental therapy services only as an employee of one or more of the following

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: No person may own or operate a mobile dentistry program in this state unless the person is registered under this section.

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: A requirement that a mobile dentistry program registrant establish procedures for a patient treated in the mobile dentistry program to access his or her patient records.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: The appliances or restorations are constructed upon receipt from a dentist of impressions or measurements, directions, and a written work authorization on a form approved by the examining board.

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: a dentist who constructs a removable prosthetic device shall mark the device with the patient's first and last name.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: The examining board shall grant a certificate to administer local anesthesia to a dental hygienist who is licensed under par. (a) or (b), and who submits evidence satisfactory to the examining board that he or she satisfies the educational requirements established in rules promulgated under s. 447.02 (2) (e).

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: The examining board shall grant a certificate to administer nitrous oxide inhalation analgesia to a dental hygienist who is licensed under par. (a) or (b) and who submits evidence satisfactory to the examining board that he or she satisfies the educational requirements established in rules promulgated under s. 447.02 (2) (j)

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: a certification to practice as an auxiliary granted under s. 447.04 (3) shall permit the holder to perform all of the following as delegated and supervised by a dentist: (a) Placement and finishing of restoration material after the dentist prepares a tooth for restoration.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Submits evidence satisfactory to the examining board that he or she has current proficiency in cardiopulmonary resuscitation, including the use of an automated external defibrillator
